predict.question: A binary design tree has a root and two outward rounds. How many nodes total?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases and inspect what changes.
bookIdea: Design involves searching alternatives under constraints on computation and attention.
modelBoundary: One option per stage creates {A} nodes; two create {B}. Extra local choices multiply later alternatives in this collision-free tree.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? This counts enumerated candidates only. It does not measure quality, attention, partial-design reuse or search-heuristic performance.
